Indian diaspora in China raises visa and anti-India content concerns

Indian diaspora members in China raised concerns about anti-India social media content and visa issues during an embassy open house. Ambassador Vikram Doraiswami assured that actions were being taken to address these matters. The embassy also indicated plans to ease visa requirements for Chinese citizens traveling to India and establish a legal assistance framework. Discussions also covered declining work visas and employment restrictions.
